text_sanskrit: यदा भूतपृथग्भावमेकस्थमनुपश्यति । तत एव च विस्तारं ब्रह्म सम्पद्यते तदा ॥ १३-३१ ॥
itrans: yadA bhUtapR^ithagbhAvamekasthamanupashyati . tata eva cha vistAraM brahma sampadyate tadA .. 13-31 ..
translation: When he properly perceives the separateness of souls from each other and from Hari, and the soul's abiding in the One (i.e., in Hari alone) and from Him alone the expansion, — he then attains to Brahman.
